note: Adapted from the species description in Mjöberg (1920); the original is in English: in the section examined only the soldier paragraph of “40. Ahamitermes nidicola n. sp.” is complete and reliable, and no attributable text was found for the other castes; only length with mandibles, length of head with mandibles and width of head are recorded; figure numbers and collection records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body white, the segments of head and thorax pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown. Head small, slightly narrowing anteriorly, longer than wide, posterior margin rounded; base of postclypeus very short, yellow, apex white; labrum large and broad, narrowing laterally, apex rounded, hairy; mandibles very short and stout, broad at the base, curved, almost devoid of teeth, only the inner margin of the left mandible with two extremely minute, almost invisible teeth; antennae pale yellow, basal segment very stout; segment 2 about half as long and half as wide as the basal segment; segment 3 extremely short, only about half as long as segment 2; segment 4 as long as segment 2; segment 5 distinctly wider than segment 4 and about equal to it in length; segments beyond segment 5 gradually lengthening, only the apical segments up to twice as long as wide, slender, apex rounded; pronotum broad, anterior margin only faintly carinate, sides rounded, narrowing towards the base; meso- and metathorax flatter and broader; legs short, femora rather stout, tarsi slender; abdomen white, sides rounded. Length with mandibles 4.4 mm, length of head with mandibles 1.56 mm, width of head 0.87 mm.
